bindings.practitioner_phrase: one practitioner actively controls heat flow or material contact
bindings.apparatus_phrase: retort crucible vessel and transfer path form one connected apparatus system
bindings.material_states_phrase: input and output material states remain simultaneously comparable
bindings.transition_phrase: color texture phase or crystal structure changes at one bounded transition zone
bindings.residue_phrase: condensate slag sediment vapor or heat discoloration traces the process

bindings.operator_phrase: one living operator performs a visible controlling action
bindings.source_phrase: one bounded source or threshold anchors the arrival
bindings.entity_phrase: one separately embodied entity emerges rather than duplicating the operator
bindings.response_phrase: gesture gaze and entity orientation create a directional operator-to-arrival relation
bindings.consequence_phrase: dust light shadow or displaced objects respond locally to the arrival
